question: In the Nutrisigma feeding trial on Garole lambs, by what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
To find the percentage difference, we need the actual values for the control group and T1. 

The cost per kg of gain for the control group is 210.00 and for T1 it is 169.94. 

Percentage difference = ((T1 - control) / control) * 100 
= ((169.94 - 210.00) / 210.00) * 100 
= (-40.06 / 210.00) * 100 
= -19.1%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.1% lower than in the control group.
